root.label: New York Times reports allegations about Peltola campaign workplace

events.label: New York Times reports allegations about Peltola campaign workplace

slots.name: Workplace allegation status
slots.sentence: Her campaign denied the allegations concerning the workplace environment but did acknowledge that she “sometimes struggled to deal with her grief” after the 2023 deaths of her mother and husband.

slots.name: Homophobic slur allegation
slots.sentence: The campaign also told the Times that Peltola had used an ableist slur and regretted doing so, but it denied allegations that she had used a homophobic slur.

slots.name: controversy date
slots.sentence: In September, Peltola’s campaign faced controversy for a New York Times report that detailed profane outbursts and displays of anger throughout the campaign and her former congressional office, citing several former Peltola aides who requested anonymity.
